title: IT Systems Administrator (Windows, Linux, AWS) - Must be US Citizen - Thousand Oaks or El Segundo, CA

cond_0001.intro:
Responsible for day-to-day deployment and support of the infrastructure within our client's environments. This position will be part of the organization that will interface with [Company name masked] employees in [Location masked] and the Americas. You will be setting up servers, etc. See the Technology responsibilities below.
Somebody with current/recent experience. 2-3 Years as an IT Sys Admin is fine. Perhaps somebody who has been a level 2-3 DeskSide person, transitioning into IT Sys Admin work and enjoys it, is ideal. If you are really smart, and can learn quickly, and have the right attitude to follow processes, then you can learn a lot on the job…..But you must have done the role before.
We want people who actually want to, love being an IT Sys Admin, are quick to learn processes, great, positive attitude, can work in a fast-paced environment and enjoy making customers happy. You must want to always do a great job for your boss, team and users. This is a fast paced, learn quickly environment. You have to love to learn and be a sponge to new tech and knowledge. If this sounds like you, then we want you.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Implementation/support of secure infrastructure which consists of networks, servers, databases, applications, and systems within the [Company name masked] Controls Hosted Services environments.
Follow direction and governance from ITSS Infrastructure and Security teams so all systems adhere to company standards and [Company name masked]'s baseline IT Security Plan.
Ensure setup and availability of business-critical customer accessible systems, focusing on uptime, and security.
Ensure the appropriate backup and archive of systems including those holding customer data, based on contractual requirements.
Maintain procedures/systems to ensure appropriate access control to customers data.
Explain highly technical solutions to non-technical staff, crisp clear communication, and ability to explain solutions and how they provide value.
Maintain system integrity and security, ensure monitoring and maintenance of component inventory, lifecycle management.
Create and maintain documentation relating to systems; networking architecture and setup/deployment.
Monitor effectiveness of existing systems. Provides improvement plans and recommendations.
Arrange monitoring and reporting of system health and performance.
Provision servers, deploy software, ensure appropriate software installations, and software upgrades/patching.
cond_0001.requirements:
To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
Competencies — To perform the job successfully, an individual should demonstrate the following competencies:
Makes things happen and works under own direction. Influences events to achieve goals. Willing and eager to take on new responsibilities. Shows enthusiasm, drive and determination.
Communicates clearly and fluently verbally and in writing. Provides regular updates to supervisor and other stakeholders.
Plans activities and projects and executes tasks to deliver desired results in a consistent, timely manner. Effectively handles multiple demands and competing priorities. Manages own time efficiently.
Must have problem solving skills: Looking at different options, analyzing issues to separate cause from symptoms, integrating approaches into complete solution. Proactively offers suggestions for improvement.
Persists with a task until it is complete. Able to carry out tasks with minimal guidance. Consistently delivers on what is promised. Makes clear and prompt decisions. Takes responsibility for outcomes.
Minimizes errors and does not repeat mistakes. Follows all work instructions when provided. Learns from success and failure. Able to cope with setbacks. Demonstrates a rapid understanding of new information. Adapts quickly to new situations.
Relates well to people at all levels. Demonstrates tact, courtesy, and flexibility. Proactively offers help and support to other team members. Promotes and maintains high standards. Demonstrates attention to detail.
Personally responsible for complying with the ethical standards and requirements established by [Company name masked]'s Ethics Code of Business Conduct.
Minimum Requirements:
Must be a U.S. Citizen.
Bachelor of Science degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or similar disciplines; one (1) to three (3) years of related experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
Must have experience with implementation and support of Windows Active Directory Domains.
Must have experience with implementation and support of Windows Server and Client systems.
Must have an intermediate knowledge of Microsoft Office Apps: Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Visio.
AWS experience: VPC; EC2; Security Groups; Transit Gateways, Storage Gateways; S3 buckets synchronization; Cloud Formation/AWS CDK; AWS Systems Manager; Cloudwatch.
Subject to FAA/DOT Program.
Preferred Requirements:
Backup/Archiving solutions e.g., Veeam, with S3.
Setup of PKI digital certificates and public-key encryption.
Implementation/support of OKTA SSO.
Implementation/support of Linux systems.
Implementation/support of Citrix Virtual Apps & Desktop (XenApp/Presentation Server).
Knowledge/ability to program and script in Windows Batch/PowerShell/JSON/YAML.

Somebody with current or recent experience is preferred. 2–3 Years as an IT Sys Admin is fine. Someone who has been a level 2–3 DeskSide person transitioning into IT Sys Admin work is ideal. If you learn quickly and follow processes well, you can build on the job — but you must have done the role before.
We want people who genuinely want to be an IT Sys Admin, pick up processes quickly, have a positive attitude, and take satisfaction in doing a good job for their boss, team, and users. You have to be willing to learn and absorb new technology and knowledge. This position requires US Citizenship.
cond_0034.responsibilities:
Essential Duties and Responsibilities include the following. Other duties may be assigned:
Implementation and support of secure infrastructure consisting of networks, servers, databases, applications, and systems within the [Company name masked] Controls Hosted Services environments.
Follow direction and governance from ITSS Infrastructure and Security teams so all systems adhere to company standards and [Company name masked]'s baseline IT Security Plan.
Ensure setup and availability of business-critical customer-accessible systems, with focus on uptime and security.
Ensure appropriate backup and archiving of systems including those holding customer data, based on contractual requirements.
Maintain procedures and systems to ensure appropriate access control to customer data.
Document highly technical solutions clearly for non-technical staff, with written explanations of how solutions provide value.
Maintain system integrity and security; carry out monitoring and maintenance of component inventory and lifecycle management.
Create and maintain documentation relating to systems, networking architecture, and setup/deployment.
Monitor effectiveness of existing systems; produce improvement plans and recommendations.
Arrange monitoring and reporting of system health and performance.
Provision servers, deploy software, and manage software installations, upgrades, and patching.
cond_0034.requirements:
To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
Works under own direction and completes tasks reliably. Willing to take on new responsibilities as needed.
Communicates clearly in writing and verbally. Provides updates to supervisor and relevant stakeholders as required.
Plans and executes tasks to deliver results in a consistent, timely manner. Handles multiple demands and manages own time efficiently.
Strong problem-solving skills: analyzes issues to separate cause from symptoms, integrates approaches into complete solutions, and offers suggestions for improvement.
Follows tasks through to completion with minimal guidance. Delivers on commitments. Takes responsibility for outcomes.
Minimizes errors and does not repeat mistakes. Follows work instructions. Adapts to new information and situations. Able to cope with setbacks.
Works well with people at all levels. Demonstrates tact and flexibility. Supports other team members. Maintains attention to detail.
Personally responsible for complying with the ethical standards established by [Company name masked]'s Ethics Code of Business Conduct.
Bachelor of Science degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or similar discipline; 1–3 years of related experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
Must have experience with implementation and support of Windows Active Directory Domains.
Must have experience with implementation and support of Windows Server and Client systems.
Must have intermediate knowledge of Microsoft Office Apps: Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Visio.
AWS experience: VPC; EC2; Security Groups; Transit Gateways; Storage Gateways; S3 buckets synchronization; Cloud Formation/AWS CDK; AWS Systems Manager; CloudWatch.
Backup/archiving solutions e.g., Veeam, with S3.
Setup of PKI digital certificates and public-key encryption.
Implementation/support of OKTA SSO.
Implementation/support of Linux systems.
Implementation/support of Citrix Virtual Apps & Desktop (XenApp/Presentation Server).
Knowledge/ability to program and script in Windows Batch/PowerShell/JSON/YAML.

We are looking for an IT Systems Administrator to join our team and take ownership of infrastructure deployment and support within client environments.
This role calls for someone with current or recent hands-on experience — 2-3 years as an IT Sys Admin, or a Level 2-3 DeskSide person who has moved into Sys Admin work and wants to keep going in that direction. You need to have done the role before, but if you learn fast, follow processes well, and have the right attitude, there is plenty to learn on the job.
We want people who genuinely want to be an IT Sys Admin, pick up processes quickly, bring a positive attitude, and care about making users happy. You have to be eager to learn and absorb new technology. If that sounds like you, we want to hear from you.
This position requires US Citizenship.

This role covers day-to-day deployment and support of infrastructure within client environments. You will regularly interface with [Company name masked] employees across multiple sites in the Americas, staying in close contact with colleagues and users to keep systems running smoothly.
We are looking for someone with 2–3 years of hands-on IT Sys Admin experience, or a Level 2–3 DeskSide person actively moving into that work. You need to have done the role before, but if you learn quickly, follow processes well, and genuinely enjoy the work, there is a lot to pick up on the job. We want someone who likes making users happy, communicates clearly, and stays engaged with the team and the people they support. US Citizenship is required.
cond_0141.responsibilities:
Implement and support secure infrastructure — networks, servers, databases, applications, and systems — within [Company name masked] hosted services environments.
Follow direction and governance from ITSS Infrastructure and Security teams, staying in regular contact with both groups so all systems meet company standards and [Company name masked]'s baseline IT Security Plan.
Ensure setup and availability of business-critical customer-accessible systems, with a focus on uptime and security.
Ensure appropriate backup and archiving of systems, including those holding customer data, based on contractual requirements.
Maintain procedures and systems to ensure appropriate access control to customer data.
Explain highly technical solutions clearly to non-technical staff; communicate trade-offs and walk users through how solutions provide value.
Maintain system integrity and security; actively monitor and maintain component inventory and lifecycle management.
Create and maintain documentation for systems, networking architecture, and setup/deployment.
Monitor effectiveness of existing systems; bring improvement plans and recommendations to the team.
Arrange monitoring and reporting of system health and performance.
Provision servers, deploy software, and handle software installations, upgrades, and patching.
cond_0141.requirements:
Bachelor of Science in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field; 1–3 years of related experience and/or training; or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
Must have experience with implementation and support of Windows Active Directory Domains.
Must have experience with implementation and support of Windows Server and Client systems.
Intermediate knowledge of Microsoft Office Apps: Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Visio.
AWS experience: VPC; EC2; Security Groups; Transit Gateways; Storage Gateways; S3 buckets synchronization; Cloud Formation/AWS CDK; AWS Systems Manager; CloudWatch.
Backup/archiving solutions e.g., Veeam, with S3.
Setup of PKI digital certificates and public-key encryption.
Implementation/support of OKTA SSO.
Implementation/support of Linux systems.
Implementation/support of Citrix Virtual Apps & Desktop (XenApp/Presentation Server).
Knowledge/ability to program and script in Windows Batch/PowerShell/JSON/YAML.
Communicates clearly and fluently, verbally and in writing; provides regular updates to supervisor and other stakeholders; comfortable explaining technical decisions and handling questions from users at all levels.
Makes things happen under own direction; willing to take on new responsibilities; proactively offers suggestions for improvement and initiates contact to resolve issues early.
Plans and executes tasks to deliver results consistently and on time; handles multiple demands and competing priorities; manages own time efficiently.
Strong problem-solving skills: analyzes issues to separate cause from symptoms and integrates approaches into complete solutions.
Persists with tasks until complete; makes clear and prompt decisions; takes responsibility for outcomes.
Minimizes errors; follows work instructions; adapts quickly to new situations and information.
Relates well to people at all levels; demonstrates tact, courtesy, and flexibility; proactively offers help and support to team members.
Personally responsible for complying with the ethical standards and requirements established by [Company name masked]'s Ethics Code of Business Conduct.

cond_0161.intro:
We are looking for an IT Systems Administrator to join our team and take ownership of infrastructure deployment and support within client environments.
This role calls for someone with current or recent hands-on experience — 2-3 years as an IT Sys Admin, or a Level 2-3 DeskSide person who has moved into Sys Admin work and wants to keep going in that direction. You need to have done the role before, but if you learn fast, follow processes well, and have the right attitude, there is plenty to learn on the job.
We want people who genuinely want to be an IT Sys Admin, pick up processes quickly, bring a positive attitude, and care about making users happy. You have to be eager to learn and absorb new technology. If that sounds like you, we want to hear from you.
This position requires US Citizenship.
cond_0161.responsibilities:
Own the implementation and support of secure infrastructure — networks, servers, databases, applications, and systems — within [Company name masked] Controls Hosted Services environments.
Follow direction and governance from ITSS Infrastructure and Security teams to ensure all systems meet company standards and [Company name masked]'s baseline IT Security Plan.
Ensure setup and availability of business-critical customer-accessible systems, with a focus on uptime and security.
Ensure appropriate backup and archiving of systems, including those holding customer data, in line with contractual requirements.
Maintain procedures and systems to enforce appropriate access control to customer data.
Communicate highly technical solutions clearly to non-technical staff, explaining how they provide value.
Maintain system integrity and security; lead monitoring and management of component inventory and lifecycle.
Create and maintain documentation for systems, networking architecture, and setup/deployment.
Monitor effectiveness of existing systems; deliver improvement plans and recommendations.
Direct monitoring and reporting of system health and performance.
Provision servers, deploy software, and execute software installations, upgrades, and patching.

THIS POSITION REQUIRES US CITIZENSHIP.
Hierarchy/Reporting To: IT Manager, Services
Supervisory Responsibilities: None currently.
Responsible for day-to-day deployment and support of the infrastructure within our client's environments. This position will be part of the organization that will interface with [Company name masked] employees in [Location masked], [Location masked], and the Americas. You will be setting up servers, etc. See the Technology responsibilities below.
Somebody with current/recent experience. 2-3 Years as an IT Sys Admin is fine. Perhaps somebody who has been a level 2-3 DeskSide person, transitioning into IT Sys Admin work and enjoys it, is ideal. If you are really smart, and can learn quickly, and have the right attitude to follow processes, then you can learn a lot on the job…..But you must have done the role before.
We want people who actually want to, love being an IT Sys Admin, are quick to learn processes, great, positive attitude, can work in a fast-paced environment and enjoy making customers happy. You must want to always do a great job for your boss, team and users. This is a fast paced, learn quickly environment. You have to love to learn and be a sponge to new tech and knowledge. If this sounds like you, then we want you.
cond_0210.responsibilities:
Essential Duties and Responsibilities include the following. Other duties may be assigned:
Implementation/support of secure infrastructure which consists of networks, servers, databases, applications, and systems within the [Company name masked] Controls Hosted Services environments.
Follow direction and governance from ITSS Infrastructure and Security teams so all systems adhere to company standards and [Company name masked]'s baseline IT Security Plan.
Ensure setup and availability of business-critical customer accessible systems, focusing on uptime, and security.
Ensure the appropriate backup and archive of systems including those holding customer data, based on contractual requirements.
Maintain procedures/systems to ensure appropriate access control to customers data.
Explain highly technical solutions to non-technical staff, crisp clear communication, and ability to explain solutions and how they provide value.
Maintain system integrity and security, ensure monitoring and maintenance of component inventory, lifecycle management.
Create and maintain documentation relating to systems; networking architecture and setup/deployment.
Monitor effectiveness of existing systems. Provides improvement plans and recommendations.
Arrange monitoring and reporting of system health and performance.
Provision servers, deploy software, ensure appropriate software installations, and software upgrades/patching.
cond_0210.requirements:
To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
Competencies — To perform the job successfully, an individual should demonstrate the following competencies:
Takes initiative and works with a degree of independence. Willing to take on new responsibilities and shows a positive, determined approach.
Communicates clearly and fluently verbally and in writing. Provides regular updates to supervisor and other stakeholders.
Plans and organizes work to deliver results in a consistent, timely manner. Able to handle multiple tasks and manage time effectively.
Ability to work through problems by looking at different options, separating cause from symptoms, and pulling together a complete solution. Open to suggesting improvements.
Follows tasks through to completion with minimal guidance. Delivers on commitments and takes responsibility for outcomes.
Pays attention to detail, learns from mistakes, and adapts to new information and situations. Able to cope with setbacks.
Relates well to people at all levels. Demonstrates tact, courtesy, and a willingness to support teammates. Maintains high standards.
Personally responsible for complying with the ethical standards and requirements established by [Company name masked]'s Ethics Code of Business Conduct.
Requirements:
Bachelor of Science degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or similar disciplines, or equivalent practical experience; around 1 to 3 years of related experience and/or training, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
Experience with implementation and support of Windows Active Directory Domains.
Experience with implementation and support of Windows Server and Client systems.
Working knowledge of Microsoft Office Apps: Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Visio.
Some experience with AWS: VPC; EC2; Security Groups; Transit Gateways, Storage Gateways; S3 buckets synchronization; Cloud Formation/AWS CDK; AWS Systems Manager; Cloudwatch.
Familiarity with Backup/Archiving solutions e.g., Veeam, with S3.
Background in setup of PKI digital certificates and public-key encryption.
Experience with or exposure to implementation/support of OKTA SSO.
Experience with or exposure to implementation/support of Linux systems.
Experience with or exposure to implementation/support of Citrix Virtual Apps & Desktop (XenApp/Presentation Server).
Some ability to program and script in Windows Batch/PowerShell/JSON/YAML.
Must be a U.S. Citizen.
Subject to FAA/DOT Program.
cond_0210.values: We value work that reflects care for people and consideration for its wider impact. We aim to make decisions in ways that are responsible, fair, and respectful.

This role calls for someone with current or recent hands-on experience — 2-3 years as an IT Sys Admin, or a Level 2-3 DeskSide person who has moved into Sys Admin work and wants to keep going in that direction. You need to have done the role before, but if you learn fast, follow processes well, and have the right attitude, there is plenty to learn on the job.
We want people who genuinely want to be an IT Sys Admin, pick up processes quickly, bring a positive attitude, and care about making users happy. You have to be eager to learn and absorb new technology. If that sounds like you, we want to hear from you.
This position requires US Citizenship.
cond_0269.responsibilities:
Own the implementation and support of secure infrastructure — networks, servers, databases, applications, and systems — within [Company name masked] Controls Hosted Services environments.
Follow direction and governance from ITSS Infrastructure and Security teams to ensure all systems meet company standards and [Company name masked]'s baseline IT Security Plan.
Ensure setup and availability of business-critical customer-accessible systems, with a focus on uptime and security.
Ensure appropriate backup and archiving of systems, including those holding customer data, in line with contractual requirements.
Maintain procedures and systems to enforce appropriate access control to customer data.
Communicate highly technical solutions clearly to non-technical staff, explaining how they provide value.
Maintain system integrity and security; lead monitoring and management of component inventory and lifecycle.
Create and maintain documentation for systems, networking architecture, and setup/deployment.
Monitor effectiveness of existing systems; deliver improvement plans and recommendations.
Direct monitoring and reporting of system health and performance.
Provision servers, deploy software, and execute software installations, upgrades, and patching.

cond_0282.intro:
We are looking for an IT Systems Administrator to join our team.
THIS POSITION REQUIRES US CITIZENSHIP.
Hierarchy/Reporting To: IT Manager, Services
Supervisory Responsibilities: None currently.
Responsible for day-to-day deployment and support of the infrastructure within our client's environments. This position will be part of the organization that will interface with [Company name masked] employees in [Location masked], [Location masked], and the Americas. You will be setting up servers, etc. See the Technology responsibilities below.
Somebody with current/recent experience. 2-3 Years as an IT Sys Admin is fine. Perhaps somebody who has been a level 2-3 DeskSide person, transitioning into IT Sys Admin work and enjoys it, is ideal. If you are really smart, and can learn quickly, and have the right attitude to follow processes, then you can learn a lot on the job…..But you must have done the role before.
We want people who actually want to, love being an IT Sys Admin, are quick to learn processes, great, positive attitude, can work in a fast-paced environment and enjoy making customers happy. You must want to always do a great job for your boss, team and users. This is a fast paced, learn quickly environment. You have to love to learn and be a sponge to new tech and knowledge. If this sounds like you, then we want you.
cond_0282.responsibilities:
Essential Duties and Responsibilities include the following. Other duties may be assigned:
Implementation/support of secure infrastructure which consists of networks, servers, databases, applications, and systems within the [Company name masked] Controls Hosted Services environments.
Follow direction and governance from ITSS Infrastructure and Security teams so all systems adhere to company standards and [Company name masked]'s baseline IT Security Plan.
Ensure setup and availability of business-critical customer accessible systems, focusing on uptime, and security.
Ensure the appropriate backup and archive of systems including those holding customer data, based on contractual requirements.
Maintain procedures/systems to ensure appropriate access control to customers data.
Explain highly technical solutions to non-technical staff, crisp clear communication, and ability to explain solutions and how they provide value.
Maintain system integrity and security, ensure monitoring and maintenance of component inventory, lifecycle management.
Create and maintain documentation relating to systems; networking architecture and setup/deployment.
Monitor effectiveness of existing systems. Provides improvement plans and recommendations.
Arrange monitoring and reporting of system health and performance.
Provision servers, deploy software, ensure appropriate software installations, and software upgrades/patching.

The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
Competencies — To perform the job successfully, an individual should demonstrate the following competencies:
Takes initiative and works with a degree of independence. Willing to take on new responsibilities and shows a positive, determined approach.
Communicates clearly and fluently verbally and in writing. Provides regular updates to supervisor and other stakeholders.
Plans and organizes work to deliver results in a consistent, timely manner. Able to handle multiple tasks and manage time effectively.
Ability to work through problems by looking at different options, separating cause from symptoms, and pulling together a complete solution. Open to suggesting improvements.
Follows tasks through to completion with minimal guidance. Delivers on commitments and takes responsibility for outcomes.
Pays attention to detail, learns from mistakes, and adapts to new information and situations. Able to cope with setbacks.
Relates well to people at all levels. Demonstrates tact, courtesy, and a willingness to support teammates. Maintains high standards.
Personally responsible for complying with the ethical standards and requirements established by [Company name masked]'s Ethics Code of Business Conduct.
Requirements:
Bachelor of Science degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or similar disciplines, or equivalent practical experience; around 1 to 3 years of related experience and/or training, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
Experience with implementation and support of Windows Active Directory Domains.
Experience with implementation and support of Windows Server and Client systems.
Working knowledge of Microsoft Office Apps: Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Visio.
Some experience with AWS: VPC; EC2; Security Groups; Transit Gateways, Storage Gateways; S3 buckets synchronization; Cloud Formation/AWS CDK; AWS Systems Manager; Cloudwatch.
Familiarity with Backup/Archiving solutions e.g., Veeam, with S3.
Background in setup of PKI digital certificates and public-key encryption.
Experience with or exposure to implementation/support of OKTA SSO.
Experience with or exposure to implementation/support of Linux systems.
Experience with or exposure to implementation/support of Citrix Virtual Apps & Desktop (XenApp/Presentation Server).
Some ability to program and script in Windows Batch/PowerShell/JSON/YAML.
Must be a U.S. Citizen.

This role covers day-to-day deployment and support of infrastructure within client environments. You will regularly interface with [Company name masked] employees across multiple sites in the Americas, staying in close contact with colleagues and users to keep systems running smoothly.
We are looking for someone with 2–3 years of hands-on IT Sys Admin experience, or a Level 2–3 DeskSide person actively moving into that work. You need to have done the role before, but if you learn quickly, follow processes well, and genuinely enjoy the work, there is a lot to pick up on the job. We want someone who likes making users happy, communicates clearly, and stays engaged with the team and the people they support. US Citizenship is required.
cond_0357.responsibilities:
Implement and support secure infrastructure — networks, servers, databases, applications, and systems — within [Company name masked] hosted services environments.
Follow direction and governance from ITSS Infrastructure and Security teams, staying in regular contact with both groups so all systems meet company standards and [Company name masked]'s baseline IT Security Plan.
Ensure setup and availability of business-critical customer-accessible systems, with a focus on uptime and security.
Ensure appropriate backup and archiving of systems, including those holding customer data, based on contractual requirements.
Maintain procedures and systems to ensure appropriate access control to customer data.
Explain highly technical solutions clearly to non-technical staff; communicate trade-offs and walk users through how solutions provide value.
Maintain system integrity and security; actively monitor and maintain component inventory and lifecycle management.
Create and maintain documentation for systems, networking architecture, and setup/deployment.
Monitor effectiveness of existing systems; bring improvement plans and recommendations to the team.
Arrange monitoring and reporting of system health and performance.
Provision servers, deploy software, and handle software installations, upgrades, and patching.
cond_0357.requirements:
Bachelor of Science in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field; 1–3 years of related experience and/or training; or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
Must have experience with implementation and support of Windows Active Directory Domains.
Must have experience with implementation and support of Windows Server and Client systems.
Intermediate knowledge of Microsoft Office Apps: Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Visio.
AWS experience: VPC; EC2; Security Groups; Transit Gateways; Storage Gateways; S3 buckets synchronization; Cloud Formation/AWS CDK; AWS Systems Manager; CloudWatch.
Backup/archiving solutions e.g., Veeam, with S3.
Setup of PKI digital certificates and public-key encryption.
Implementation/support of OKTA SSO.
Implementation/support of Linux systems.
Implementation/support of Citrix Virtual Apps & Desktop (XenApp/Presentation Server).
Knowledge/ability to program and script in Windows Batch/PowerShell/JSON/YAML.
Communicates clearly and fluently, verbally and in writing; provides regular updates to supervisor and other stakeholders; comfortable explaining technical decisions and handling questions from users at all levels.
Makes things happen under own direction; willing to take on new responsibilities; proactively offers suggestions for improvement and initiates contact to resolve issues early.
Plans and executes tasks to deliver results consistently and on time; handles multiple demands and competing priorities; manages own time efficiently.
Strong problem-solving skills: analyzes issues to separate cause from symptoms and integrates approaches into complete solutions.
Persists with tasks until complete; makes clear and prompt decisions; takes responsibility for outcomes.
Minimizes errors; follows work instructions; adapts quickly to new situations and information.
Relates well to people at all levels; demonstrates tact, courtesy, and flexibility; proactively offers help and support to team members.
Personally responsible for complying with the ethical standards and requirements established by [Company name masked]'s Ethics Code of Business Conduct.

cond_0377.intro:
We are looking for an IT Systems Administrator to join our team and take ownership of infrastructure deployment and support within client environments.
This role calls for someone with current or recent hands-on experience — 2-3 years as an IT Sys Admin, or a Level 2-3 DeskSide person who has moved into Sys Admin work and wants to keep going in that direction. You need to have done the role before, but if you learn fast, follow processes well, and have the right attitude, there is plenty to learn on the job.
We want people who genuinely want to be an IT Sys Admin, pick up processes quickly, bring a positive attitude, and care about making users happy. You have to be eager to learn and absorb new technology. If that sounds like you, we want to hear from you.
This position requires US Citizenship.
cond_0377.responsibilities:
Own the implementation and support of secure infrastructure — networks, servers, databases, applications, and systems — within [Company name masked] Controls Hosted Services environments.
Follow direction and governance from ITSS Infrastructure and Security teams to ensure all systems meet company standards and [Company name masked]'s baseline IT Security Plan.
Ensure setup and availability of business-critical customer-accessible systems, with a focus on uptime and security.
Ensure appropriate backup and archiving of systems, including those holding customer data, in line with contractual requirements.
Maintain procedures and systems to enforce appropriate access control to customer data.
Communicate highly technical solutions clearly to non-technical staff, explaining how they provide value.
Maintain system integrity and security; lead monitoring and management of component inventory and lifecycle.
Create and maintain documentation for systems, networking architecture, and setup/deployment.
Monitor effectiveness of existing systems; deliver improvement plans and recommendations.
Direct monitoring and reporting of system health and performance.
Provision servers, deploy software, and execute software installations, upgrades, and patching.

THIS POSITION REQUIRES US CITIZENSHIP.
Hierarchy/Reporting To: IT Manager, Services
Supervisory Responsibilities: None currently.
Responsible for day-to-day deployment and support of the infrastructure within our client's environments. This position will be part of the organization that will interface with [Company name masked] employees in [Location masked], [Location masked], and the Americas. You will be setting up servers, etc. See the Technology responsibilities below.
Somebody with current/recent experience. 2-3 Years as an IT Sys Admin is fine. Perhaps somebody who has been a level 2-3 DeskSide person, transitioning into IT Sys Admin work and enjoys it, is ideal. If you are really smart, and can learn quickly, and have the right attitude to follow processes, then you can learn a lot on the job…..But you must have done the role before.
We want people who actually want to, love being an IT Sys Admin, are quick to learn processes, great, positive attitude, can work in a fast-paced environment and enjoy making customers happy. You must want to always do a great job for your boss, team and users. This is a fast paced, learn quickly environment. You have to love to learn and be a sponge to new tech and knowledge. If this sounds like you, then we want you.
cond_0426.responsibilities:
Essential Duties and Responsibilities include the following. Other duties may be assigned:
Implementation/support of secure infrastructure which consists of networks, servers, databases, applications, and systems within the [Company name masked] Controls Hosted Services environments.
Follow direction and governance from ITSS Infrastructure and Security teams so all systems adhere to company standards and [Company name masked]'s baseline IT Security Plan.
Ensure setup and availability of business-critical customer accessible systems, focusing on uptime, and security.
Ensure the appropriate backup and archive of systems including those holding customer data, based on contractual requirements.
Maintain procedures/systems to ensure appropriate access control to customers data.
Explain highly technical solutions to non-technical staff, crisp clear communication, and ability to explain solutions and how they provide value.
Maintain system integrity and security, ensure monitoring and maintenance of component inventory, lifecycle management.
Create and maintain documentation relating to systems; networking architecture and setup/deployment.
Monitor effectiveness of existing systems. Provides improvement plans and recommendations.
Arrange monitoring and reporting of system health and performance.
Provision servers, deploy software, ensure appropriate software installations, and software upgrades/patching.
cond_0426.requirements:
To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
Competencies — To perform the job successfully, an individual should demonstrate the following competencies:
Takes initiative and works with a degree of independence. Willing to take on new responsibilities and shows a positive, determined approach.
Communicates clearly and fluently verbally and in writing. Provides regular updates to supervisor and other stakeholders.
Plans and organizes work to deliver results in a consistent, timely manner. Able to handle multiple tasks and manage time effectively.
Ability to work through problems by looking at different options, separating cause from symptoms, and pulling together a complete solution. Open to suggesting improvements.
Follows tasks through to completion with minimal guidance. Delivers on commitments and takes responsibility for outcomes.
Pays attention to detail, learns from mistakes, and adapts to new information and situations. Able to cope with setbacks.
Relates well to people at all levels. Demonstrates tact, courtesy, and a willingness to support teammates. Maintains high standards.
Personally responsible for complying with the ethical standards and requirements established by [Company name masked]'s Ethics Code of Business Conduct.
Requirements:
Bachelor of Science degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or similar disciplines, or equivalent practical experience; around 1 to 3 years of related experience and/or training, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
Experience with implementation and support of Windows Active Directory Domains.
Experience with implementation and support of Windows Server and Client systems.
Working knowledge of Microsoft Office Apps: Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Visio.
Some experience with AWS: VPC; EC2; Security Groups; Transit Gateways, Storage Gateways; S3 buckets synchronization; Cloud Formation/AWS CDK; AWS Systems Manager; Cloudwatch.
Familiarity with Backup/Archiving solutions e.g., Veeam, with S3.
Background in setup of PKI digital certificates and public-key encryption.
Experience with or exposure to implementation/support of OKTA SSO.
Experience with or exposure to implementation/support of Linux systems.
Experience with or exposure to implementation/support of Citrix Virtual Apps & Desktop (XenApp/Presentation Server).
Some ability to program and script in Windows Batch/PowerShell/JSON/YAML.
Must be a U.S. Citizen.
Subject to FAA/DOT Program.
cond_0426.values: We value achievement, high standards, and work that is carried out with real discipline. We believe strong organizations are defined by the quality of what they deliver.

This role covers day-to-day deployment and support of infrastructure within client environments. You will regularly interface with [Company name masked] employees across multiple sites in the Americas, staying in close contact with colleagues and users to keep systems running smoothly.

This role covers day-to-day deployment and support of infrastructure within client environments. You will regularly interface with [Company name masked] employees across multiple sites in the Americas, staying in close contact with colleagues and users to keep systems running smoothly.

This position will be part of the organization that will interface with [Company name masked] employees in [Location masked] and the Americas. You will be setting up servers, etc. See the Technology responsibilities below.
Somebody with current/recent experience. 2-3 Years as an IT Sys Admin is fine. Perhaps somebody who has been a level 2-3 DeskSide person, transitioning into IT Sys Admin work and enjoys it, is ideal. If you are really smart, and can learn quickly, and have the right attitude to follow processes, then you can learn a lot on the job…..But you must have done the role before.
We want people who actually want to, love being an IT Sys Admin, are quick to learn processes, great, positive attitude, can work in a fast-paced environment and enjoy making customers happy. You must want to always do a great job for your boss, team and users. This is a fast paced, learn quickly environment. You have to love to learn and be a sponge to new tech and knowledge. If this sounds like you, then we want you. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the systems and infrastructure work involved.
cond_0571.responsibilities:
Essential Duties and Responsibilities include the following. Other duties may be assigned:
Implementation/support of secure infrastructure which consists of networks, servers, databases, applications, and systems within the [Company name masked] Controls Hosted Services environments.
Follow direction and governance from ITSS Infrastructure and Security teams so all systems adhere to company standards and [Company name masked]'s baseline IT Security Plan.
Ensure setup and availability of business-critical customer accessible systems, focusing on uptime, and security.
Ensure the appropriate backup and archive of systems including those holding customer data, based on contractual requirements.
Maintain procedures/systems to ensure appropriate access control to customers data.
Explain highly technical solutions to non-technical staff, crisp clear communication, and ability to explain solutions and how they provide value.
Maintain system integrity and security, ensure monitoring and maintenance of component inventory, lifecycle management.
Create and maintain documentation relating to systems; networking architecture and setup/deployment.
Monitor effectiveness of existing systems. Provides improvement plans and recommendations.
Arrange monitoring and reporting of system health and performance.
Provision servers, deploy software, ensure appropriate software installations, and software upgrades/patching.

cond_0573.intro:

You need to have done the role before, but if you learn quickly, follow processes well, and genuinely enjoy the work, there is a lot to pick up on the job. We want someone who likes making users happy, communicates clearly, and stays engaged with the team and the people they support. US Citizenship is required.

cond_0585.intro:
We are looking for an IT Systems Administrator to join our team supporting infrastructure within client environments. This role is part of an organization that works closely with [Company name masked] employees across the Americas. US Citizenship is required.
We are looking for someone with current or recent hands-on experience — 2–3 years as an IT Systems Administrator, or someone coming from a Level 2–3 DeskSide role who is moving into systems administration and enjoys that kind of work. If you learn quickly, follow processes well, and have done the role before, there is a lot to learn here on the job.
We want people who genuinely enjoy being an IT Systems Administrator, pick up processes quickly, bring a positive attitude, and care about keeping users happy. You should want to do a great job for your team and users, and be eager to keep learning as the technology evolves.
cond_0585.responsibilities:
Work together with the infrastructure and security teams to support and deploy secure infrastructure — including networks, servers, databases, applications, and systems — within [Company name masked] Controls Hosted Services environments.
Follow direction and governance from ITSS Infrastructure and Security teams so all systems stay aligned with company standards and [Company name masked]'s baseline IT Security Plan.
Help ensure setup and availability of business-critical customer-accessible systems, with a shared focus on uptime and security.
Coordinate with relevant teams to ensure appropriate backup and archiving of systems, including those holding customer data, based on contractual requirements.
Work with colleagues to maintain procedures and systems that ensure appropriate access control to customer data.
Communicate highly technical solutions clearly to non-technical staff, and help them understand how those solutions provide value.
Support system integrity and security, and assist with monitoring and maintenance of component inventory and lifecycle management.
Create and maintain shared documentation relating to systems, networking architecture, and setup/deployment.
Work with the team to monitor the effectiveness of existing systems, and contribute improvement plans and recommendations.
Coordinate monitoring and reporting of system health and performance.
Assist with provisioning servers, deploying software, and ensuring appropriate software installations and upgrades/patching.
cond_0585.requirements:
To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor of Science degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or similar discipline; 1–3 years of related experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
Experience with implementation and support of Windows Active Directory Domains.
Experience with implementation and support of Windows Server and Client systems.
Intermediate knowledge of Microsoft Office Apps: Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Visio.
Must be a U.S. Citizen.
Subject to FAA/DOT Program.
